mapper.sql: (SELECT 'review' AS kind, id, title, summary, photos, status, status_before_trash, author_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, category, cohort FROM reviews UNION ALL SELECT 'interview', id, title, summary, photos, status, status_before_trash, author_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, NULL, cohort FROM interviews UNION ALL SELECT 'project', id, service_name, summary, photos, status, status_before_trash, author_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, NULL, cohort FROM projects) s LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = s.author_id

WHERE s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
AND (LOWER(s.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{s.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.summary, '')) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{s.keyword}, '%')))
mapper.select: SELECT s.kind, s.id, s.deleted_at FROM WHERE s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.kind, s.id
SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM interviews WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort DESC
SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM projects WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort DESC
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interviews) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects)
mapper.sql: t.id, t.status, t.status_before_trash, t.author_id, u.name AS author_name, t.published_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, t.summary, t.photos
'review' AS kind, t.title, , t.category, t.cohort, t.senior_name, t.body, t.tags, t.show_on_hub
'interview' AS kind, t.title, , t.cohort, t.senior_name, t.track, t.qa, t.video_url, t.video_length
'project' AS kind, t.service_name AS title, , t.cohort, t.class_name, t.major, t.team_name, t.team_size, t.project_subject AS headline, t.problem, t.features, t.tech, t.tags, t.links
WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY t.published_at DESC, t.id DESC
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reviews t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM interviews t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM projects t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM reviews t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id
SELECT FROM interviews t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id
SELECT FROM projects t LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = t.author_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (category, cohort, senior_name, title, summary, body, tags, show_on_hub, photos, status, author_id, published_at) VALUES (#{category}, #{cohort}, #{seniorName}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{body}, #{tags}, COALESCE(#{showOnHub}, FALSE), #{photos}, #{status}, #{authorId}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT INTO interviews (cohort, senior_name, track, title, summary, qa, video_url, video_length, photos, status, author_id, published_at) VALUES (#{cohort}, #{seniorName}, #{track}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{qa}, #{videoUrl}, #{videoLength}, #{photos}, #{status}, #{authorId}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT INTO projects (cohort, class_name, major, team_name, team_size, service_name, project_subject, summary, problem, features, tech, tags, links, photos, status, author_id, published_at) VALUES (#{cohort}, #{className}, #{major}, #{teamName}, #{teamSize}, #{title}, #{headline}, #{summary}, #{problem}, #{features}, #{tech}, #{tags}, #{links}, #{photos}, #{status}, #{authorId}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.sql: summary = #{summary}, photos = #{photos}, status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET title = #{title}, , category = #{category}, cohort = #{cohort}, senior_name = #{seniorName}, body = #{body}, tags = #{tags}, show_on_hub = COALESCE(#{showOnHub}, FALSE) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE projects SET service_name = #{title}, , cohort = #{cohort}, class_name = #{className}, major = #{major}, team_name = #{teamName}, team_size = #{teamSize}, project_subject = #{headline}, problem = #{problem}, features = #{features}, tech = #{tech}, tags = #{tags}, links = #{links} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ${table} SET status = #{status}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE published_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status_before_trash = status, status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = COALESCE(status_before_trash, 'HIDDEN'), status_before_trash = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, deleted_at FROM ${table} WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
